source: Alfa Instrumentos, Manual de Configuração e Operação, Balança de Fluxo (0053.MN.02.A), section 6.1 Dados em Modbus TCP

sources.title: Manual de Configuração e Operação - Balança de Fluxo
sources.note: Section 6.1; supplied with the map request

notes: Modbus TCP on port 502. The device sends 13 signed integer registers starting at register 200.

The manual names the 32-bit values Hi and Lo in that order (200 Hi, 201 Lo), so the word order is big. It does not state the unit or the decimals of the weight, flow and accumulated value; values are raw.
The data table is shown on the controller: Menu, CLP configuration (maintenance password in the manual), Ethernet parameters, Data table.
